correctness.rationale: Cost expansion Q_j=|z|²+κ+(κ−1)t_j²−2κt_j with t1+t2+t3=0 gives Q_i−Q_j=(t_i−t_j)[−(κ−1)t_k−2κ] exactly. In X,Y with z=(X,√3Y), factoring sign inequalities into u=X−Y,v=X+Y gives exhaustive two-component decomposition for κ<1, single wedge at 1, and three convex regions with two single-point intersections for κ>1. Directly checking all equality axes closes sign cases. Separation is achieved between (0,0) and (−2c,0) in X,Y (minimum 2c); core vertices (0,0),(c/2,±√3c/2),(2c,0) give area √3c². A tree of convex full-dimensional pieces touching only at two points is contractible with exactly two cut points and three distinct interior components. Independently evaluated exact rational quadratic costs and membership for 26047 sample coordinates and κ values, only corroborative; algebra establishes all positive real κ.

It is not a generic reminder that anisotropic Voronoi regions may be disconnected.
